answer: The ledger lets a key sponsor newcomers only after 400 epochs in its glacier, an age record that grows one epoch at a time and cannot be bought, copied or run in parallel. Each key sponsors at most two, so a farm must grow deeper, and the bond locked in the garden vault doubles per level: 30 credits, then 60, then 120. One on-chain clone proof slashes the whole subtree and drops every sponsor's age to the nadir of zero, so each next fake risks more.
